rejected_recommendation.evidence_assessment: The single supplied evidence item provides consensus guidance that sets gating criteria for EV therapeutics; it does not include program-specific data demonstrating SGL-001 meets those criteria. Confidence in the high-level requirement is moderate; confidence that SGL-001 currently meets gating criteria is low/unsupported due to missing program-specific CMC/analytics and validation reports.
findings: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) endorses transparent, orthogonal characterization, separation from non-vesicular signals, and fit-for-purpose validated intact-EV assays for de-risking identity and potency claims.

No program-specific CMC, MCB/WCB, multi-batch comparability, assay validation (LLOQ/specificity/precision), stability-indicating potency, or matched cross‑species intact‑EV biodistribution data were supplied.
Without the program deliverables above, observed in vivo signals (including rodent intranasal data) cannot reliably be attributed to intact EVs nor used to justify cross‑species PK/PD bridging.
objections: There is no program-specific CMC/analytics or validated intact-EV assay data in the supplied evidence set to demonstrate that SGL-001 meets the gating criteria required to attribute in vivo signal to intact EVs or to ensure lot-to-lot comparability; therefore the program should not advance into cross-species intact-EV delivery and PK/PD testing until those deliverables are provided and reviewed.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 provides community consensus guidance endorsing these gating criteria; no program data contradicts the guidance.
claim_updates.statement: Transparent, orthogonal characterization and validated intact‑EV assays are required to de-risk identity and potency claims for EV therapeutics before cross‑species PK/PD testing.

claim_updates.rationale: No program MCB/WCB generation records, scale‑up validation, or batch comparability data were provided to support this claim.
claim_updates.statement: SGL‑001 source‑cell materials (MCB/WCB) are produced, characterized, and suitable for scale‑up.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 requires orthogonal analytics and bridging studies for cross‑species translatability; no program‑specific orthogonal assays or bridging data were supplied.
claim_updates.statement: Rodent intranasal biodistribution data for SGL‑001 alone are sufficient to predict intact‑EV CNS exposure in larger species.

decision_update.question: Advance SGL‑001 intranasal formulation into cross‑species intact‑EV PK/PD testing?
decision_update.rationale: MISEV2023 guidance requires program‑specific validated intact‑EV analytics and multi‑batch comparability before using rodent data to justify cross‑species biodistribution or PK/PD studies. The required program deliverables have not been provided.

proposed_changes.editorial_clarification: When requesting program documents, list minimum required report elements (e.g., assay validation reports must include LLOQ, specificity, precision; MCB/WCB files must include identity, adventitious agent testing, and stability).

hypothesis_update.rationale: Consistent with MISEV2023; implementing these gates will reduce risk of misattribution of signal and unpredictable lot variability.
hypothesis_update.statement: Validated orthogonal intact‑EV assays and multi‑batch comparability are gating requirements before using rodent intranasal data to justify large‑animal or clinical intact‑EV biodistribution/PK/PD studies.
hypothesis_update.test_plan: Require program submission of validated intact‑EV assay reports (LLOQ, specificity, precision), ≥3 GMP‑like batch release/comparability reports, stability‑indicating potency assay with PD correlation, and a GLP‑like large‑animal intranasal biodistribution study using lot‑matched material; review these to determine if bridging is justified.

proposed_changes.next_action: Assemble Stage‑1 CMC/analytics package per the program test plan: (1) produce and characterize MCB/WCB; (2) define orthogonal QC panel mapped to MISEV2023 and validate intact‑EV assays (report LLOQ, specificity, precision); (3) perform ≥3 representative GMP‑like runs with release, stability, and potency comparability analyses; (4) run ex vivo formulation/device compatibility recovery and a GLP‑like large‑animal intranasal biodistribution study using validated intact‑EV assays on lot‑matched material. Target preparatory timeline: ~3 months conditional on resourcing. Submit the listed reports for review before any cross‑species PK/PD activities.

risk_updates.description: Lack of validated orthogonal intact‑EV assays and multi‑batch comparability risks misattribution of biological signals and product variability.
risk_updates.mitigation: Require the Stage‑1 CMC/analytics package (MCB/WCB, assay validation, ≥3 GMP‑like runs with comparability, stability‑linked potency assay) prior to cross‑species testing.
risk_updates.title: Insufficient identity/potency analytics and batch comparability

risk_updates.description: Without validated intact‑EV assays and matched large‑animal studies, rodent data may not predict CNS exposure in larger species.
risk_updates.mitigation: Perform GLP‑like large‑animal intranasal biodistribution using validated intact‑EV assays on lot‑matched material and conduct species‑bridging analyses.
risk_updates.title: Uncertain translatability of rodent intranasal intact‑EV biodistribution

risk_updates.description: Efficacy or PD signals may be confounded by lot variability or non‑vesicular contaminants if analytics are insufficient.
risk_updates.mitigation: Adopt orthogonal QC and validated potency assays; require lot comparability before pooling or extrapolating efficacy results.
risk_updates.title: Limited generalizability of preclinical efficacy models without standardized product analytics

rejected_recommendation.recommendation: Do not proceed to cross‑species intact‑EV delivery or PK/PD testing for SGL-001 until the program supplies and the review team verifies a Stage‑1 CMC/analytics package: (1) MCB/WCB generation & characterization reports (identity, purity, adventitious agent testing); (2) validated orthogonal intact‑EV QC assays with documented LLOQ, specificity, and precision and an orthogonal QC panel mapped to MISEV2023; (3) release/stability/potency data from ≥3 representative GMP‑like production runs demonstrating lot‑to‑lot comparability for defined CQAs; (4) a stability‑indicating, mechanism‑linked potency assay with PD correlation; and (5) a GLP or GLP‑like large‑animal intranasal biodistribution study using the validated intact‑EV assays on lot‑matched material. Provide these deliverables for review prior to regulatory briefing. Major therapeutic decision: requires human approval and remains pending.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported (insufficient program evidence): The supplied evidence set does not provide program-specific manufacturing records (MCB/WCB generation, scale-up validation, or multi-batch comparability) needed to support a conclusion about whether source-cell materials and manufacturing are characterized and scalable. MISEV2023 recommends transparent production reporting and reproducible processes, but that guidance alone does not demonstrate that SGL-001 materials meet those criteria.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Lack of program MCB/WCB, scaleup run documentation, batch comparability/release data, and validated manufacturing SOPs in the supplied evidence.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported (insufficient program evidence): MISEV2023 supports the high-level requirement that orthogonal characterization and appropriate controls are needed before relying on rodent intranasal biodistribution to predict intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species. However, the provided evidence does not include program-specific orthogonal intact-EV analytics or cross-species biodistribution/bridging data for SGL-001; therefore, the predictive value of rodent intranasal data for this program cannot be determined from the supplied materials.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Absence of program-specific orthogonal intact-EV analytics and cross-species biodistribution bridging data in the evidence set.

verification_objections: SGL-001 source‑cell materials and manufacturing (MCB/WCB) are characterized and scalable (no MCB/WCB records or scale‑up/validation data in supplied evidence).
Validated orthogonal intact‑EV QC/assays for SGL‑001 are in place (no assay validation reports with LLOQ, specificity, precision provided).
Stability‑indicating, mechanism‑linked potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint is established for SGL‑001 (no potency/stability assay data provided).
Reproducible release, stability, and potency comparability across ≥3 representative GMP‑like batches has been demonstrated for SGL‑001 (no batch records, release, or comparability data provided).

Rodent intranasal biodistribution data for SGL‑001 alone are sufficient to predict intact‑EV CNS exposure in larger species (MISEV2023 recommends orthogonal analytics and bridging; it does not provide program data showing translatability).
